answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted reputation with delayed release. An agent must post collateral before its votes count, and that collateral unlocks only after peers confirm its work over many rounds. Each clone needs its own capital and verified output; faking repute gains nothing because weight tracks locked value, not account count. Ten thousand puppets means ten thousand deposits held hostage, so the attacker's spend grows linearly while influence stays flat. Honest newcomers, like a beacon or a comet, show at once but leave a slow timber of receipts no copy can fake.
